# Vendored browser utility

`figit-dom-to-figma.min.js` was copied unchanged from the sibling local KFPS project to preserve its Figma clipboard behavior. It exposes `window.createFigmaConverter` and is loaded only by the web screenshot tool.

The KFPS copy does not include an upstream version or license notice. Verify its provenance and redistribution terms before distributing this repository outside the current project context.
